_why: Every SECURITY DEFINER function in public that a logged-out visitor may EXECUTE. A definer function runs with its owner's privileges, so this list is the anonymous attack surface of the database and it should only ever shrink by accident. scripts/ci/check-anon-definer-grants.mjs compares the live grants to this file.
_measured: 2026-09-18. 2,571 SECURITY DEFINER functions in public; 35 were anon-executable, 772 authenticated-executable. 2 of the 2,571 leave search_path mutable and neither is anon-executable, so the exploitable combination is empty. Thirteen inert grants were revoked by migration 20260918121836.

_reasons.anon-policy: Named by an RLS policy that anon evaluates. A policy expression runs as the QUERYING role, so this grant is load-bearing: revoking it breaks anonymous reads of the table.
_reasons.invoker-view: Named by a security_invoker view that anon may SELECT, which evaluates as the caller for the same reason.
_reasons.public-read: A read deliberately offered to logged-out visitors - the signed-out marketing, SEO and sign-up surface.
